Appendix A. Testing Methodology This appendix covers the testing methodology to collect data on the EVSE and vehicles modeled for CHIL implementation. A.1 EVSE Nominal Power Transfer Nominal power transfer tests were performed to understand EVSE performance at specific test points within its nominal operating area. Table A-1 presents the set point values that the EVSE was tested at, where the current is progressed from 10 A to the maximum amperage in steps of 10 A for the voltage levels listed (within the supported range). A.3 Off-Nominal Grid Input Off-nominal grid input tests constitute changes in input voltage, input frequency, and input voltage harmonics that are outside of the hardware’s nominal operating window to observe the impact on the hardware itself. Table A-3 shows high-level information for the off-nominal tests including the two operating states, one at maximum power and another at a lower power. Table A-3.
